# Resources API endpoints
{: .no_toc}

Resources are the shared catalog used by every lab: consumables (probe designs, virus constructs, reagents), hardware devices and suppliers. Changes by users without approval rights become approval requests.

## Resources

| Resource | What it is | Portals |
|:---------|:-----------|:--------|
| [`consumable`](/api/resources/consumable/) | The shared catalogue of single-use products, such as probe designs, virus constructs and reagents. | private, public |
| [`hardwaredevice`](/api/resources/hardwaredevice/) | The shared catalogue of durable devices, such as amplifiers, cameras and lasers. | private, public |
| [`supplier`](/api/resources/supplier/) | The shared list of companies and labs that supply consumables, hardware and animals. | private, public |

## Supporting endpoints

Approval requests, membership invitations and link tables. Most workflows never call these directly; the main resources create and resolve them.

| Resource | What it is | Portals |
|:---------|:-----------|:--------|
| [`consumableapproval`](/api/resources/consumableapproval/) | A request to add or change a shared consumable, reviewed before it takes effect. | private |
| [`hardwaredeviceapproval`](/api/resources/hardwaredeviceapproval/) | A request to add or change a shared hardware device, reviewed before it takes effect. | private |
| [`supplierapproval`](/api/resources/supplierapproval/) | A request to add or change a shared supplier, reviewed before it takes effect. | private |

All endpoints follow `https://www.brainstem.org/api/{portal}/resources/{resource}/` and support the common [query parameters](/api/#query-parameters).
